P000.desc: A kind-hearted young man who grew up in a small, remote village. Having saved his village from monsters when he was a child, he vows to become strong.
P000.name: Shiren

P001.desc: The young head of a prestigious noble family. Possessing both elegance and a strong sense of responsibility, he aspires to reform the corrupt aristocratic society. He is calm but also has a passionate side.
P001.name: Ashley

P002.desc: Born into a prestigious family of lancers in the royal army, he left home to work as a mercenary and bodyguard.
P002.name: Kiji

P003.desc: A genius magician born in a forest dense with magical energy. From a young age, her magical power tended to run wild, and she has a delicate constitution where her emotions are directly linked to her power.
P003.name: Mireille

P004.desc: A righteous outlaw who grew up in the slums and has survived since childhood through agility and quick thinking.
P004.name: Kai

P005.desc: A long-lived elf girl who lives in a deep forest. She possesses the ability to hear the voices of nature and spirits, and was raised as a guardian of the forest.
P005.name: Leafa

P006.desc: A troubadour who weaves stories while traveling. Raised in a port town tavern, he has learned songs and folklore from all over the world.
P006.name: Rude

P007.desc: A dancer born in a desert oasis city. Since childhood, she has captivated travelers with her dance and song.
P007.name: Fiona

P008.desc: An orphan raised in a desolate arena. With the teachings of his adoptive master in his heart, he continues his journey in search of true strength.
P008.name: Ranga

P009.desc: Born into a clan of ninjas who live hidden away in a misty mountain village. He will throw himself into any danger for the sake of his mission, and will even break the rules to protect his comrades.
P009.name: Shigure

P010.desc: An elite born into a family of royal guards protecting the kingdom. He has a strict personality, but is kinder to the weak than anyone else.
P010.name: Clarice

P011.desc: Born into a family of traveling merchants, he is an experienced merchant who has traveled to various places since childhood. He values not only profit but also human connections and conducts business honestly with everyone.
P011.name: Roche

P012.desc: A young man from the Koropokkuru, a small race that lives in the northern forests. They are a people who live in harmony with nature and possess the ability to communicate with plants and animals.
P012.name: Pokkle
